glosses: vis, gevogelte of wild van de ingewanden ontdoen

translations.source_sense_description: vis, gevogelte of wild van de ingewanden ontdoen

glosses: To disembowel; to remove the viscera.

examples.text: Desecrate me / Tear me limb from limb / Eviscerate me / Chew me to death

glosses: To destroy or make ineffectual or meaningless.

examples.text: Coming on stage at sunrise on the Sunday, Jefferson Airplane greet the new day explaining they’re not a “hippie band” but “manic morning music”, then eviscerate Fred Neil’s Other Side of Life. Somebody to Love is also taken at breakneck speed – this turns out to be an energy tablet before a leaden day.
Earlier the gentleman from California (Mr. Cardoza) got up on the floor, and he was upset that somebody had said that the underlying bill would eviscerate the Endangered Species Act.

glosses: To remove a bodily organ or its contents.
To protrude through a surgical incision.

translations.source_sense_description: vis, gevogelte of wild van de ingewanden ontdoen

glosses: Quitar las achuras de la res.
Por extensión, quitar a alguno la vida, en especial si a cuchilladas o con saña.
Marcar un área en un dibujo o imagen usando líneas paralelas.

examples.text: Determinar las ecuaciones de las asíntotas y achurar claramente la región limitada por ellas, la rama de C con y ≤ 0 y la recta que contiene al lado recto de la misma rama.
